args.body:
• Newsletter (Halvorsen Supply, "Freight pricing this quarter"): spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Main article (blog.halvorsen.example/2026/freight): confirms the spot-rate drop and contract-rate stability, and notes surcharges are indexed to weekly diesel prices.
• Companion piece (insights.halvorsen.example/freight/companion): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Halvorsen Supply Freight Newsletter Summary
